items.why: RUN THE FIX launches a versioned drill directly, but RAGE QUIT passes only four text fields to the menu. HomeV2 then clears them and starts a plain run, so a player who accepts the visible menu order receives no activeRunDrill and no outcome receipt.
items.recipe: Create one bounded menu-drill envelope carrying sanitized contract copy, drill identity, seed, baseline wave/score, launch kind, and acceptance time. Make DeathScreen hand that envelope to the menu, let Commander's Orders render its contract, and have every deploy action pass the envelope through challengeOpts.drill before consumption.
items.measurement: Pure tests reject malformed or oversized fields and preserve baseline/seed. Component tests prove DeathScreen hands off a drill envelope, HomeV2 deploy passes it, and App creates activeRunDrill. Existing direct RUN THE FIX behavior remains green.

items.why: When an active drill does generate an outcome, the result is currently inside the collapsed secondary-analysis block. The first viewport immediately prescribes another fix without first telling the player whether the accepted prior correction improved, held, or regressed against its baseline.
items.recipe: Render one compact LAST ORDER RESULT receipt immediately before ONE VERDICT whenever drillOutcome exists. Show observed-versus-baseline wave, comparable score delta only when valid, and repeatability evidence without causal language. Remove the duplicate detailed outcome from the collapsed analysis.

items.recipe: Build a portable weapon-mastery projection from career.weaponLegendKills and attach it to every mature-player Commander's Order as a compact supporting receipt: weapon, current tier/kills, next tier, kills remaining, source, and all-open availability. Keep input proof, onboarding, and last-run correction precedence unchanged; do not auto-switch weapons or claim projected time.
items.measurement: Pure tests cover zero-kill, threshold, legend-complete, unavailable-evidence, and order precedence. HomeV2 component coverage proves the receipt is driven by career.weaponLegendKills and renders no invented target when evidence is absent.
